answer.answer: The accident-insurance programme abbreviated PMSBY is the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana [E01]. Its cover is triggered by death or disability on account of an accident [E01]. Specifically, the scheme provides: Rs. 2 Lakhs on death to the nominee [E01]; Rs. 2 Lakhs for total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes, loss of use of both hands or feet, or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot [E01]; and Rs. 1 Lakh for total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PMSBY is the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
It is an accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover
Death triggers Rs. 2 Lakhs payout to nominee
Total loss of both eyes or both hands/feet or one eye and one hand/foot triggers Rs. 2 Lakhs
Loss of one eye or one hand/foot triggers Rs. 1 Lakh
